purpose: Public, non-sensitive verification register; not a deployment attestation

classification_definitions.source-only: Claim supported by source documentation or code, without independent runtime execution
classification_definitions.DEV-reported: Historical DEV result stated in a source document; not independently reproduced
classification_definitions.DEV-verified: Directly observed DEV behaviour with dated, attributable test evidence
classification_definitions.mock-only: Synthetic demonstration or simulated integration, not a live provider transaction
classification_definitions.production-verified: Directly observed production behaviour with authorised, dated evidence
classification_definitions.proposed: Reference design or acceptance criteria, not implemented
